messages:
Amy (AE): FYI — Acme just sent a hard requirement: run the POC inside their VPC, egress only via their proxy, BYOK with HSM, and streaming preserved. They also asked us to guarantee tail latency targets (p99-ish) for demo. cc @Sam (SE) @Jordan (Solutions Eng)
Sam (SE): Thanks. short answer: doable but not without tradeoffs. HSM unwraps + proxy hops add latency. Need expected qps, average seq length, and whether they need embeddings or generative endpoints.
Jordan (Solutions Eng): If we do Dedicated in their VPC and colocate the runtime, we can keep token latency low. Two quick mitigations: session-level key caching to avoid per-token HSM calls, and a local egress proxy with persistent connections. But that requires customer firewall rules & a CIDR allowlist.
Leah (InfoSec): Security checklist: BYOK with external HSM OK, but we need attestation proof and key wrap/unwrap flow documented. Also require audit log forwarding (syslog or cloud logging). Please confirm they accept our KMS integration pattern and provide the vendor certs.
Amy (AE): They said 30 concurrent users, mostly generation, avg output ~256 tokens, and bursts to ~120 qps during demos. POC timeline: they want kickoff next Tue (10 business days). Budget: TBD but they asked if price changes for this setup.
Sam (SE): Quick back-of-envelope: 120 qps * 256 tokens ≈ 30k tokens/s peak. With streaming and the extra network egress + dedicated bandwidth, this will push us into Dedicated-burst pricing. Expect ~+30-50% on unit costs for the POC compared to standard hosted. Will confirm with finance.
Sam (SE): Config snippet for session caching idea (for review):
```
# session cache pseudo-config
session_cache:
  ttl: 10m            # cache unwrapped DEK per session
  max_sessions: 1000
kms_call_strategy: batched
  batch_size: 16
  timeout_ms: 50
```
Jordan (Solutions Eng): That reduces HSM latency from per-request to ~1 call/session, helps a lot for p99. Also recommend keep-alives to the proxy and increasing the streaming window to avoid TLS renegotiation.
Amy (AE): Two deployment options to propose to customer:
- Option A: Hosted Private (fast) — our control plane, VPC peering + proxy tunnel, BYOK via customer HSM proxy. Spin-up 3-5 days but limited guaranteed isolation.
- Option B: Dedicated Private (longer) — their VPC/on-prem package with isolated Dedicated nodes, full audit + SLA, spin-up ~2-3 weeks, higher cost but best latency and isolation.
Leah (InfoSec): For security sign-off, Option B is preferred. Option A acceptable only with extra attestations and an ATO checklist completed. Also need to confirm they can forward audit logs to our collector.
Amy (AE): Customer reply: they prefer fastest route (Option A) but insist on HSM and p99 targets. They said they'll provide firewall rules if needed.
Sam (SE): Action items: 1) I will run a quick capacity calc + estimate pricing delta and post by EOD. 2) Jordan, can you draft the minimal network allowlist and proxy config? 3) Leah, send the specific questionnaire fragments we need answered (HSM vendor, attestation, log endpoints).
Jordan (Solutions Eng): On it — drafting allowlist and sample proxy config. Will include a streaming checklist.
Leah (InfoSec): I'll extract the KMS/HSM sections and highlight must-haves.
ops-bot: Created infra ticket INF-7896 to provision VPC tunnel and test endpoints (assigned to eng-infra).
Amy (AE): One last ask from customer: can we do a short dry-run with 10 qps today to validate connections? If yes, we can reduce risk for the Tue kickoff.
Sam (SE): I can run the dry-run but we need credentials + NAT rules now. If they can provide a test endpoint and turn up the proxy for a 30-min window we can smoke-test streaming and HSM unwrap behavior.
Amy (AE): I'll chase the customer for test creds.
Jordan (Solutions Eng): Also putting a note: if they insist on per-request HSM unwrap (no caching), call it out as a blocker — p99 will be unpredictable and costs will spike.
Leah (InfoSec): Agreed. Flagging that as a security requirement vs operational tradeoff — will need explicit sign-off.
Amy (AE): OK folks — thanks. Let's converge on Option A with session caching and a clear ATO checklist unless the customer confirms Dedicated. I'll update the customer after Sam posts price delta. :thumbsup:
Sam (SE): Price delta posted in thread — see calc doc internal link (sent).
Jordan (Solutions Eng): Follow-up: adding the proxy keepalive snippet to the allowlist doc.
Leah (InfoSec): I'll post the KMS checklist link in #shared-sec soon.
Amy (AE): Great — tracking in the POC playbook. Closing this thread once we get test creds.
